observations: A dark olive-green four-legged figure stands upright at center, its rounded head enclosed by a thin circular outline, with red crossed lines layered over both eye areas.
A looped pink-and-blue line forms a collar shape at the figure's neck; yellow outlines trace the feet and a rectangular patch on the lower torso.
The background carries broad tan and cream washes overlaid with orange-yellow blocks upper left, teal horizontal strokes, loose black spirals, and red-orange shapes lower right.
reading: A dark upright figure holds the frame, its face crossed with red lines that read as both decoration and obstruction. The thin circle around the head separates it from a busy background without fully enclosing it. The pink-blue collar introduces a softer note against the olive and black mass. Something between display and unease sits in that combination of adornment and crossed-out eyes.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbor nnxyz nnotb #247 shares the upright animal-figure format but works in high-key yellow against this work's muted tan field. The collector links nnxyz's line-over-wash layering to the engraved-line quality of scrimshaw.

connections.reason: Both works place a decorated upright animal figure at center with loose black outlines over layered washes, but nnxyz nnotb #247 floods the field with warm yellow while nnxyz nnotb #248 holds to a cooler tan-and-olive ground.
nnxyz nnotb #249 repeats the dark-filled upright cat form with red X marks over the eyes, making the crossed-line face motif a direct formal echo across both works.

lookingQuestion: What does the thin circular line around the figure's head do to the relationship between the figure and the marks behind it?
ambiguities: The rectangular mark on the lower torso and the yellow foot outlines may be separate symbolic elements or part of a single ground-plane indicator; the image does not resolve this.
nnxyz nifty faces #48 shows no useful formal connection beyond shared artist and is excluded from connections.
